oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to neladalkib for previously treated locally advanced or metastatic ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer
oce.summary: On November 17, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to neladalkib (Nelkarmi, Nuvalent, Inc.), a kinase inhibitor, for adults with locally advanced or metastatic anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who have previously received the following therapy in the unresectable locally advanced or metastatic setting: • one prior ALK tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) consisting of alectinib, or • two or more prior ALK TKIs and platinum-based chemotherapy.

oce.title: FDA approves giredestrant in combination with everolimus for ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1 -mutated locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
oce.summary: On November 16, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved giredestrant (Wilserdly, Genentech, Inc.), an oral estrogen receptor antagonist, in combination with everolimus for the treatment of adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, estrogen receptor 1 ( ESR1) -mutated locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-authorized test, whose disease has recurred during or after completion of endocrine-based adjuvant therapy, or has progressed on at least one endocrine-based regimen in the metastatic setting.

oce.title: FDA approves durvalumab with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv for muscle invasive bladder cancer
oce.summary: On November 13, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved durvalumab (Imfinzi, AstraZeneca) in combination with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv as neoadjuvant treatment, followed by single agent durvalumab as adjuvant treatment after radical cystectomy, for the treatment of adult patients with muscle invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) who are ineligible for or who have refused cisplatin based chemotherapy.

oce.title: FDA approves pimicotinib for symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor
oce.summary: On November 10, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved pimicotinib (Pimjetmi, EMD Serono, Inc.), a kinase inhibitor, for adults with symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT) for which surgical resection may cause worsening functional limitation or severe morbidity.

oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
oce.summary: On November 5, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj (Rybrevant Faspro, Janssen Biotech, Inc.) for adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy and an anti-PD-(L)1 antibody. Amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj is not indicated for patients with oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) that is HPV-associated.

oce.title: FDA approves talazoparib with enzalutamide for metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive prostate cancer with HRR gene mutations
oce.summary: On October 26, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved talazoparib (Talzenna, Pfizer Inc.) in combination with enzalutamide for the treatment of adults with metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive (mAPMN/S) prostate cancer with homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene mutations, as detected by an FDA-authorized test.

oce.title: FDA grants traditional approval for pembrolizumab or pembrolizumab and berahyaluronidase alfa-pmph for unresectable or metastatic TMB-H solid tumors with updated indication
oce.summary: On October 16, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted traditional approval to pembrolizumab (Keytruda, Merck) or pembrolizumab and berahyaluronidase alfa-pmph (Keytruda Qlex, Merck) for adult and pediatric patients with unresectable or metastatic tumor mutational burden-high (TMB-H) [≥13 mutations/megabase (mut/Mb)] solid tumors, as determined by an FDA-authorized test, that have progressed following prior treatment and who have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.

oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to dostarlimab for locally advanced rectal cancer
oce.summary: On October 19, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab (Jemperli, GSK) for adults with Stage II/III locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) that is microsatellite instability high (MSI-H) or mismatch repair deficient (dMMR), as determined by an FDA-authorized test for solid tumors.

oce.title: FDA approves an expanded indication for nogapendekin alfa inbakicept-pmln for BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer
oce.summary: On October 14, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved nogapendekin alfa inbakicept-pmln (Anktiva, Altor BioScience, LLC, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of ImmunityBio, Inc.) with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) for adults with BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). This revises the prior indication for adults with BCG-unresponsive NMIBC with carcinoma in situ (CIS) with or without papillary tumors to include patients with high-grade papillary-only tumors.

oce.title: FDA approves atezolizumab in combination with chemotherapy for Stage III mismatch repair deficient colon cancer
oce.summary: On October 8, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved atezolizumab (Tecentriq, Genentech, Inc.) in combination with a fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for the adjuvant treatment of adult and pediatric patients two years of age and older with Stage III mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) colon cancer. The FDA also approved atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-tqjs (Tecentriq Hybreza, Genentech, Inc.) in combination with a fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for the adjuvant treatment of adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who weigh 40 kg or greater with Stage III dMMR colon cancer.

oce.title: FDA approves tucatinib with trastuzumab and pertuzumab for the maintenance treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer
oce.summary: On October 7, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved tucatinib (Tukysa, Seagen Inc., a subsidiary of Pfizer) in combination with trastuzumab and pertuzumab for the maintenance treatment of adults with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer following induction treatment.

oce.title: FDA approves pirtobrutinib for previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma
oce.summary: On October 2, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca, Eli Lilly and Company) for adult patients with previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL) with no known 17p deletion.

oce.title: FDA approves belzutifan in combination with lenvatinib for advanced renal cell carcinoma with a clear cell component
oce.summary: On September 24, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved belzutifan (Welireg, Merck & Co., Inc.) in combination with lenvatinib (Lenvima, Eisai Inc.) for adults with advanced renal cell carcinoma with a clear cell component (ccRCC) following a programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1) or programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) inhibitor.

oce.title: FDA approves lirafugratinib for previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma
oce.summary: On September 23, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved lirafugratinib (Lyrfigtu, Elevar Therapeutics, Inc.), a kinase inhibitor, for the treatment of adults with previously treated unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) gene fusion or other rearrangement.

oce.title: FDA approves imlunestrant in combination with abemaciclib for ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer
oce.summary: On September 18, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved imlunestrant (Inluriyo) in combination with abemaciclib (Verzenio), for adults with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1)-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer, as detected by an FDA-authorized test, with disease progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy. Inluriyo and Verzenio are manufactured by Eli Lilly and Company.

oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to sevabertinib for locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
oce.summary: On September 9, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to sevabertinib (Hyrnuo, Bayer Healthcare Pharmaceuticals Inc.), a kinase inhibitor, for adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) activating mutations, as detected by an FDA-authorized test.

oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to camizestrant with a CDK4/6 inhibitor for ESR1-Mutated HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
oce.summary: On September 4, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to camizestrant (Etcamah, AstraZeneca), an estrogen receptor antagonist, in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (abemaciclib, palbociclib, or ribociclib) for adults with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer upon detection of estrogen receptor-1 (ESR1) mutation during aromatase inhibitor and CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, based on an FDA-authorized test.

oce.title: FDA approves daraxonrasib for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma
oce.summary: On August 26, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved daraxonrasib (RASONQUE, Revolution Medicines, Inc.), an inhibitor of the RAS GTPase family, for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy.

oce.title: FDA approves zanidatamab-hrii and tislelizumab-jsgr for HER2-positive gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma
oce.summary: On August 25, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved zanidatamab-hrii (Ziihera, Jazz Pharmaceuticals) in combination with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-containing chemotherapy and tislelizumab-jsgr (Tevimbra, BeOne Medicines USA, Inc.), as first-line treatment for adults with HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+) unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and in combination with fluoropyrimidine-, and platinum-containing chemotherapy, as first-line treatment for adults with HER2-positive (IHC 3+) unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, as detected by an FDA-approved test.: dolutegravir

oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to iberdomide with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone for multiple myeloma
oce.summary: On August 13, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to iberdomide (Zenbexus, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company) in combination with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone for adults with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent.

oce.title: FDA grants accelerated approval to vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg in combination with nivolumab for melanoma
oce.summary: On August 6, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg (Tudriqev, Replimune, Inc.), a genetically modified oncolytic viral therapy, in combination with nivolumab for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable advanced cutaneous melanoma who experienced disease progression on a programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1)-blocking antibody-based regimen.

oce.title: FDA approves lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan with androgen receptor pathway inhibitor therapy for metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive prostate cancer
oce.summary: On July 31, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan (Pluvicto, Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation) in combination with androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) therapy for adults with prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-positive metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or-sensitive (mAPMN/S) prostate cancer (previously referred to as metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer).

oce.title: FDA approves zidesamtinib for ROS1 -positive non-small cell lung cancer
oce.summary: On July 22, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved zidesamtinib (Jideytro, Nuvalent, Inc.) for adults with locally advanced or metastatic ROS1 -positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) who received at least one prior ROS1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI).
